_comment: Phase 2 parity gate fixture (docs/plans/write-the-phased-plan-wobbly-pancake.md). One instance of every DocumentModel block type from content/SCHEMA.md's taxonomy, shaped exactly as scripts/content/blockClassifier.js emits it. Both the web and Compose block registries must have a renderer for every type here -- the coverage test in each platform enumerates these types and fails if one has no registered renderer.
